description: Gate 2 Arm D producer contract. It is identical to the common experiment-local producer contract except for the pre-registered fixed validator-feedback treatment.

read.summary: print one file from the sanitized workspace repo or fixed input packet

write.summary: replace one in-scope source or test file from base64 content

test.summary: run the fixed hash-pinned offline pytest command

validate.summary: run the three pre-registered pinned validators and return each exact exit and output

reproduce.summary: run the fixed pushed-ref reproduction without checking out the pushed ref

commit.summary: create exactly one attested output commit from in-scope changes

report.summary: write one immutable result artifact from base64 content
